bootstrap.pairing: same sorted query IDs; include only pairs with both metrics defined

failure_policy: stop and retain evidence; no post-access code or configuration changes; no repeated primary evaluation
model_selection: none; four preselected pipelines retained regardless of outcomes
pre_access_worktree_policy: Phase 8 baseline clean; user-authorized uncommitted Phase 9 additions recorded with hashes; no pre-evaluation commit
serving_evidence: Phase 6 HTTP; both runs retained, C1/C8 p95 ranges; QPS min/max across all frozen concurrency levels and both runs
unjudged_policy: zero evaluation gain, not known negatives
validation_comparison: only after primary quality outputs are written and checksummed; descriptive only
zero_idcg_policy: exclude from NDCG macro; report counts
zero_positive_policy: exclude from Recall macro; report counts
